items.headline: Anthropic sets Nasdaq IPO price range at $70–$78/share, targeting $1.4T valuation in up to $90.4B raise (IPO + private placement)
items.why: Would be the largest-ever public listing and first frontier AI lab IPO, setting the market benchmark for AI-lab valuations.

items.headline: Broadcom signs $42B custom-chip note agreement with Anthropic, expects to be its largest custom-silicon customer in 2027
items.why: Confirms Broadcom's AI ASIC backlog and diversification beyond Google/Meta, a key bull case for AVGO.

items.headline: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate hit $80B in October 2026, up from $65B in July (WSJ), ahead of ~$1.4T IPO pricing
items.why: Hypergrowth (80x YoY) supports premium IPO valuation but invites scrutiny on durability of consumption-based revenue vs OpenAI competition

items.headline: Anthropic agrees to pay $3.4B for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators to power AI data centers
items.why: Largest known single power-equipment purchase by an AI lab, showing labs bypassing grid bottlenecks directly.

items.headline: OpenAI closes roughly $11B of new funding at $1.25T valuation, below its original $1.4–1.5T target amid an AI stock selloff
items.why: Signals financing terms are tightening even for the top lab, a read-through for private AI valuations broadly.

items.headline: Google to invest $17B in Wyoming AI data center campus bought from Crusoe
items.why: Adds to hyperscaler capex arms race underpinning AI infrastructure demand

items.headline: PBOC shifts policy anchor to the overnight repo rate, pushing Chinese bank funding costs to record lows
items.why: De facto monetary easing signal for China, relevant to China AI-stock risk appetite and yuan-linked capex.

items.headline: Shield AI to buy radar maker Echodyne for $5.3B, raising $2.5B incl. $1B Series H at $28.8B valuation
items.why: Major AI-defense consolidation and a $1B+ markup showing AI-autonomy valuations still rising despite broader selloff

items.headline: Tencent releases 'Hy4' model, claims top-tier status among China's open-weight AI systems, beating DeepSeek and Zhipu
items.why: Shows China's open-weight AI race intensifying, pressuring both domestic rivals and US model pricing power.

items.headline: Anthropic amends IPO S-1 with Q3 results as it targets a pre-Thanksgiving (Nov 26) Nasdaq listing
items.why: Would be the largest AI-lab IPO to date; amended filing and timeline are the clearest signal the listing is proceeding despite valuation debate

items.headline: Anthropic discloses plan for up to $895B in compute spending commitments and ~$17B revenue run-rate ahead of IPO
items.why: Quantifies the scale of AI-lab capex/compute lock-in investors are underwriting via the IPO

items.headline: Marvell agrees to combine with Lumentum in ~$115B deal
items.why: Consolidates AI custom-silicon (Marvell) with optical/data-center components (Lumentum), key AI-infra supply chain tie-up

items.headline: OpenAI cuts new funding round target by ~$10B to ~$20B amid AI-stock selloff, still eyes $1.25T valuation
items.why: Signals investor caution on AI financing pace even for the top lab; bridge round ahead of a planned 2027 IPO

items.headline: ECB holds rates at 2.65%; Lagarde says a hike was discussed but board held unanimously
items.why: Keeps eurozone policy steady but flags hawkish tilt, relevant to global rate outlook and risk appetite for AI/tech valuations

items.headline: Samsung says its 2027 HBM memory supply is already sold out
items.why: Confirms HBM scarcity extending another year, supporting pricing power for memory makers feeding AI chip demand
